strategy.summary: Shoot the right spinner into the top-center saucer to light the spinner and select the two collect arrows. Build both base bonuses, light 2x, then shoot the upper-left saucer for the collect on five-ball rules.

steps.text: Plunge for the top-center saucer. Watch the upper-left saucer reject and kickout.
From the left flipper, shoot the right spinner to return the ball to the top-center saucer.
modeNotes: Top-center saucer: Ten-point switches cycle the left and right arrows every switch. The 2x lamp toggles every second switch, independently of the arrows.
A made saucer also lights the spinner for 1,000 per spin.

steps.text: Collect the left arrow, right arrow, and green 2x award at the top-center saucer.
From the right flipper, shoot the upper-left saucer. Repeat it while the made-shot and missed-shot returns stay controlled.
modeNotes: Three-ball rules: The saucer advances both base bonuses by three before collecting the side or sides shown by the lit arrows.
Five-ball rules: The saucer advances each base bonus once only while neither collect arrow is lit. Once a collect is lit, the saucer collects without advancing that bonus.
The full repeatable value needs both base bonuses at 29,000, both collect arrows lit, and 2x.

steps.text: On five-ball rules, build both bonuses before lighting their collect arrows. After both collects and 2x are ready, use the upper-left saucer for the full value.

fallback.title: A-F carried bonus
fallback.when: Use this when the upper-left saucer will not hold the ball or its kickout is unsafe.

steps.text: Collect A-F through the two top lanes, two top standups, and two return lanes.
Complete A-F once for 20,000 carried end-of-ball bonus.
Complete it again for 30,000 carried end-of-ball bonus.

alternatives.title: Lit spinner
alternatives.when: Use this when the spinner is strong and the bumper exit is safe.

steps.text: Make the top-center saucer to light the spinner for 1,000 per spin.
Repeat the right spinner from the left flipper.
Use each trip to the top to collect a missing arrow or 2x award.
On five-ball rules, shoot the upper-left saucer while neither collect arrow is lit until both base bonuses reach 29,000.
Use the top-center saucer to light both collect arrows and 2x. Read the arrow and 2x lamp cycles independently.
Shoot the upper-left saucer to collect both 29,000 bonuses at 2x for 116,000.

techniques.name: Saucer half-miss
techniques.instruction: Graze the edge of the upper-left chute. Use the contact to slow a shot that otherwise rims out.

techniques.name: Soft or fluttered saucer shot
techniques.instruction: Use a short or fluttered flip to remove speed. The goal is to drop the ball into the saucer, not drive it through the mouth.

techniques.name: Live catch
techniques.instruction: Read the upper-left saucer kickout. Nudge and catch it on the right flipper before repeating the shot.

cautions.issue: A hard upper-left saucer shot can rim out and return faster than a made shot.
cautions.response: Use a half-miss, soft flip, or flutter. Prepare a separate control move for made and missed returns.

cautions.issue: The upper-left saucer kickout can feed the center drain.
cautions.response: Test it before committing to the repeat route. Nudge early and catch on the right flipper when possible.

cautions.issue: Most drains start at a bumper exit or a sling.
cautions.response: Use the spinner and saucer routes. Avoid direct rebound shots unless they complete a valuable A-F award.

quickInfo.name: Main route
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the right spinner into the top-center saucer, build both bonuses, light both collect arrows and 2x, then shoot the upper-left saucer.

quickInfo.name: Long goal
quickInfo.summary: On five-ball rules, shoot the upper-left saucer while neither collect arrow is lit until both base bonuses reach 29,000.

quickInfo.name: Safer fallback
quickInfo.summary: A-F carried bonus: Use this when the upper-left saucer will not hold the ball or its kickout is unsafe.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Bally Nitro Ground Shaker, ball count, Bonus X rules, and award conversions.
Test both saucers, the spinner, lane change, and lower-bank rebounds.

noteDetails.label: Top-player proof
items: At the Bulls&Balls Okayest Weekend 2022, Craig Pennuto shot the spinner and top saucer, then repeatedly collected the side indicated by its lit bonus arrow.

strategy.simpleOverview: In Nitro Ground Shaker, shoot the right spinner into the top-center saucer to light the spinner and cycle the left collect arrow, right collect arrow, and 2x lamp. On five-ball rules, build both base bonuses before lighting their collect arrows; once both arrows and 2x are lit, shoot the upper-left saucer to collect both bonuses at 2x.
strategy.overview: In Nitro Ground Shaker, ten-point switches cycle the two collect arrows at the top-center saucer and toggle its 2x lamp every second switch. Shoot the right spinner into that saucer to light the spinner and select the needed awards. On five-ball rules, first build both base bonuses to 29,000, then light both arrows and 2x before shooting the upper-left saucer for the 116,000 collect. On three-ball rules, the upper-left saucer advances both bases before collecting the lit side or sides.
